overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, focused academic and professional presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. Engagement is consistently high across all platforms, driven largely by announcements regarding research grants, software releases (CooRnet v2.0), academic publications, and recruitment opportunities in computational social science.

contentThemes.description: Focuses on computational methods, publications, and conference presentations regarding information operations and link-sharing behavior.
Announcements related to research funding, hiring postdocs, and seeking PhD students in computational social science.
Updates on software development and tool releases like CooRnet v2.0 for data analysis.

recommendations: Increase visual media usage (e.g., charts, infographics of research findings) to boost repost and share rates across Bluesky and Mastodon.
Leverage LinkedIn's strong absolute reach (1,850 followers) by creating longer-form post breakdowns or articles explaining tool functionalities and research implications.
Cross-promote engagement on Bluesky to Mastodon and LinkedIn to convert viral repost momentum into institutional connections.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest engagement rate (~6.14%), with users actively reposting announcements regarding papers, research opportunities, and upcoming conference talks.
platformInsights.mastodon: Provides solid niche engagement (~4.55% rate) with a technical audience particularly interested in open-source tools like CooRnet and methodology discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest raw interaction count (up to 107 interactions per post) and excels at broadcasting major professional milestones like grants and postdoctoral job openings.
